notes: Zertal 2005 Site 184 (Wadi Ahmar (4); entry grid 1920/1652, 200 m W of the unit point) describes a large oval enclosure, an inner enclosure, a rectangular structure, monoliths and walls. It describes no pool, pit or grave, so features is empty. The water source is 'Ein el-Mana, 900 m away, a spring. Plan Fig. 367 (p. 513) shows only enclosure walls and wadi channels. The header field 'Cisterns: none' is recorded as an explicit C2 absence, but it covers cisterns only.
